  <div id="scene"></div>

  <div class="hud">

    </div>

    </nav>
  </div>

  <div id="loading">Preparing harbor scene…</div>

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    const container = document.getElementById("scene");
    const loading = document.getElementById("loading");

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Renderer, scene, camera, and lighting
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      antialias: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.08;
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    renderer.domElement.setAttribute("aria-label", "Interactive 3D buoy tender scene");
    container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x9bc7d8);
    scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x9bc7d8, 0.009);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      42,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      250
    );

    const hemisphere = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xcceeff, 0x173a43, 2.1);
    scene.add(hemisphere);

    const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff1d2, 3.3);
    sun.position.set(-12, 20, 10);
    sun.castShadow = true;
    sun.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    sun.shadow.camera.left = -18;
    sun.shadow.camera.right = 18;
    sun.shadow.camera.top = 18;
    sun.shadow.camera.bottom = -18;
    sun.shadow.camera.near = 1;
    sun.shadow.camera.far = 60;
    sun.shadow.bias = -0.0004;
    scene.add(sun);

    const fillLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x8bc9e4, 0.8);
    fillLight.position.set(12, 8, -14);
    scene.add(fillLight);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Materials and geometry helpers
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const materials = {
      hull: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x0c3447,
        roughness: 0.42,
        metalness: 0.22,
        side: THREE.DoubleSide
      }),
      hullDark: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x071e2b,
        roughness: 0.48,
        metalness: 0.2
      }),
      red: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xb9382f,
        roughness: 0.48,
        metalness: 0.12
      }),
      deck: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x52666b,
        roughness: 0.9,
        metalness: 0.08
      }),
      white: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xe9eeee,
        roughness: 0.5,
        metalness: 0.12
      }),
      metal: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x87989c,
        roughness: 0.3,
        metalness: 0.8
      }),
      darkMetal: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x26383e,
        roughness: 0.38,
        metalness: 0.72
      }),
      yellow: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xf2b52b,
        roughness: 0.38,
        metalness: 0.38
      }),
      orange: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xf46b21,
        roughness: 0.45,
        metalness: 0.12
      }),
      glass: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x173f50,
        roughness: 0.16,
        metalness: 0.55,
        emissive: 0x081a22,
        emissiveIntensity: 0.35
      }),
      rope: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xd2b77c,
        roughness: 0.95
      }),
      black: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x10191c,
        roughness: 0.7
      })
    };

    const Y_AXIS = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);

    function cylinderBetween(
      start,
      end,
      radius,
      material,
      parent,
      radialSegments = 10
    ) {
      const a = start.isVector3 ? start : new THREE.Vector3(...start);
      const b = end.isVector3 ? end : new THREE.Vector3(...end);
      const direction = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(b, a);
      const length = direction.length();

      const geometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
        radius,
        radius,
        length,
        radialSegments
      );

      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
      mesh.position.copy(a).add(b).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(Y_AXIS, direction.normalize());
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      parent.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function addBox(
      size,
      position,
      material,
      parent = scene,
      castShadow = true
    ) {
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(size[0], size[1], size[2]),
        material
      );
      mesh.position.set(...position);
      mesh.castShadow = castShadow;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      parent.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Animated water
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const waterGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(180, 180, 100, 100);
    waterGeometry.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);

    const waterPosition = waterGeometry.attributes.position;
    const waterBase = new Float32Array(waterPosition.count * 3);

    for (let i = 0; i < waterPosition.count; i++) {
      waterBase[i * 3] = waterPosition.getX(i);
      waterBase[i * 3 + 1] = waterPosition.getZ(i);
    }

    const waterMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x287b8c,
      roughness: 0.28,
      metalness: 0.42
    });

    const water = new THREE.Mesh(waterGeometry, waterMaterial);
    water.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(water);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Buoy tender hull
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const boat = new THREE.Group();
    boat.position.y = 0.02;
    scene.add(boat);

    const hullStations = [
      { x: -4.70, width: 0.88, top: 1.15, bottom: 0.18 },
      { x: -4.15, width: 1.12, top: 1.15, bottom: -0.25 },
      { x: -2.80, width: 1.25, top: 1.15, bottom: -0.25 },
      { x:  2.70, width: 1.25, top: 1.15, bottom: -0.25 },
      { x:  3.70, width: 0.95, top: 1.05, bottom: 0.18 },
      { x:  4.70, width: 0.08, top: 1.05, bottom: 0.18 }
    ];

    const hullPositions = [];
    const hullIndices = [];

    for (const station of hullStations) {
      const w = station.width;
      const t = station.top;
      const b = station.bottom;

      const section = [
        [-w, t],
        [-w * 0.92, t + (b - t) * 0.4],
        [-w * 0.58, b],
        [ w * 0.58, b],
        [ w * 0.92, t + (b - t) * 0.4],
        [ w, t]
      ];

      for (const [z, y] of section) {
        hullPositions.push(station.x, y, z);
      }
    }

    for (let stationIndex = 0; stationIndex < hullStations.length - 1; stationIndex++) {
      for (let j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
        const a = stationIndex * 6 + j;
        const b = stationIndex * 6 + ((j + 1) % 6);
        const c = (stationIndex + 1) * 6 + j;
        const d = (stationIndex + 1) * 6 + ((j + 1) % 6);

        hullIndices.push(a, c, b, b, c, d);
      }
    }

    const hullGeometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    hullGeometry.setAttribute(
      "position",
      new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(hullPositions, 3)
    );
    hullGeometry.setIndex(hullIndices);
    hullGeometry.computeVertexNormals();

    const hull = new THREE.Mesh(hullGeometry, materials.hull);
    hull.castShadow = true;
    hull.receiveShadow = true;
    boat.add(hull);

    // Deck outline, shaped to taper toward the bow.
    const deckShape = new THREE.Shape();
    deckShape.moveTo(-4.70, -1.15);
    deckShape.lineTo(-4.15, -1.35);
    deckShape.lineTo(-2.80, -1.45);
    deckShape.lineTo( 2.70, -1.45);
    deckShape.lineTo( 3.70, -1.00);
    deckShape.lineTo( 4.70,  0.00);
    deckShape.lineTo( 3.70,  1.00);
    deckShape.lineTo( 2.70,  1.45);
    deckShape.lineTo(-2.80,  1.45);
    deckShape.lineTo(-4.15,  1.35);
    deckShape.closePath();

    const deckGeometry = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(deckShape, {
      depth: 0.16,
      bevelEnabled: true,
      bevelThickness: 0.035,
      bevelSize: 0.035,
      bevelSegments: 2,
      steps: 1
    });
    deckGeometry.rotateX(Math.PI / 2);

    const deck = new THREE.Mesh(deckGeometry, materials.deck);
    deck.position.y = 1.30;
    deck.castShadow = true;
    deck.receiveShadow = true;
    boat.add(deck);

    // Red rubbing stripe along both hull sides.
    function addHullStripe(side) {
      const positions = [];
      const indices = [];

      for (const station of hullStations) {
        positions.push(
          station.x, 0.55, side * station.width * 0.985,
          station.x, 0.76, side * station.width * 0.985
        );
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < hullStations.length - 1; i++) {
        const a = i * 2;
        const b = a + 1;
        const c = a + 2;
        const d = a + 3;
        indices.push(a, b, c, b, d, c);
      }

      const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      geometry.setAttribute(
        "position",
        new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3)
      );
      geometry.setIndex(indices);
      geometry.computeVertexNormals();

      const stripe = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, materials.red);
      stripe.castShadow = true;
      boat.add(stripe);
    }

    addHullStripe(-1);
    addHullStripe(1);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Railings
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function addRailSegment(start, end, parent = boat) {
      cylinderBetween(start, end, 0.035, materials.metal, parent, 8);
    }

    function addPost(x, z, y, height, parent = boat) {
      cylinderBetween(
        [x, y, z],
        [x, y + height, z],
        0.038,
        materials.metal,
        parent,
        8
      );
    }

    // Stern rail.
    addPost(-4.72, -1.13, 1.31, 1.02);
    addPost(-4.72,  1.13, 1.31, 1.02);
    addRailSegment([-4.72, 2.33, -1.13], [-4.72, 2.33, 1.13]);

    // Side rails.
    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      const z = side * 1.43;

      addPost(-4.10, z, 1.31, 1.02);
      addPost(-2.80, z, 1.31, 1.02);
      addPost( 2.70, z, 1.31, 1.02);
      addPost( 3.70, z, 1.31, 0.90);

      addRailSegment([-4.10, 2.33, z], [ 2.70, 2.33, z]);
      addRailSegment([ 2.70, 2.33, z], [ 3.70, 2.33, z]);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Deck plate seams
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    for (const z of [-0.76, 0.76]) {
      addBox([6.7, 0.012, 0.025], [-0.45, 1.308, z], materials.darkMetal, boat, false);
    }

    for (const x of [-3.65, -1.25, 1.15, 3.25]) {
      addBox([0.025, 0.012, 1.28], [x, 1.308, 0], materials.darkMetal, boat, false);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Winches
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const winchHandles = [];

    function makeWinch(x, z, rotation = 0) {
      const group = new THREE.Group();
      group.position.set(x, 1.30, z);
      group.rotation.y = rotation;
      boat.add(group);
